runs.noTimeline: No timeline was recorded for this run. The transcript of its session shows what happened.
runs.noSession: This run has no session of its runtime to show.
runs.noLogs: No log lines for this session.
runs.continueHint: A new run of the agent resumes this run's session, with everything it already knows, and does what you write here.
runs.continuePlaceholder: What should the agent do next?

sessions.empty: The runtime has no sessions yet.
sessions.tools: {count, plural, one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}

memory.approvalOn: Changes the agent makes to its memory wait for your approval; until then it keeps working with the approved version.
memory.approvalOff: The agent changes its memory itself. Every version is kept below.
memory.pending: {count, plural, one {# change waits for approval} other {# changes wait for approval}}
memory.notReported: The runtime has not reported its memory yet.

proposals.updateHint: Hermes is updated for every agent. The helper keeps a backup and rolls back on its own if the update or the check after it fails.
proposals.localPatches: {count, plural, one {# local change is carried over: {list}} other {# local changes are carried over: {list}}}

usage.unpriced: Some models have no price in the price table; their cost is missing from the sums.

spend.tokensDetail: Input {input} (of which cached {cached}) · output {output} (of which reasoning {reasoning})
spend.costHint: Cost by the model price table
spend.costPartial: Not every model has a price; the cost is incomplete

runtime.healthHint: Runs the runtime's own check (Hermes doctor). It takes up to a minute.
runtime.curatorPaused: The curator is paused: it is off in the agent's learning settings.
runtime.pinHint: The curator never archives or changes a pinned skill.
runtime.noLogs: This runtime keeps no log Helena can read.

errors.offline: The agent's runner is offline, so its runtime cannot be read right now.
errors.timeout: The runtime did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.noRuntime: This agent's runtime cannot show this.

emergencyStop.bannerTitle: Emergency stop: all agents are halted
emergencyStop.activeSince: On since {since}. No agent starts or continues work; runs that were stopped continue their session once you resume.
emergencyStop.confirmText: No agent starts a run or answers a chat any more, running work stops at its next heartbeat and Hermes pauses. Resuming continues the stopped runs in their sessions.

fallback.ownHint: When the agent's model fails or is rate-limited, Hermes switches to these, in order.
fallback.defaultHint: Off: the instance's fallback models apply (Administrator → Agent runtime).
fallback.none: No fallback models: a failing model ends the run.

admin.stopDescription: Halts every agent of the instance at once. Also in the account menu.
admin.hermesDescription: The Hermes installation all agents run on. An update needs your approval; the helper keeps a backup and rolls back when it fails.
admin.behind: {count, plural, one {# change up to {version}} other {# changes up to {version}}}
admin.requested: The update waits for approval on the approvals page.
admin.changelog: {count, plural, one {What changes (# commit)} other {What changes (# commits)}}
admin.localPatches: {count, plural, one {# local change is carried over: {list}} other {# local changes are carried over: {list}}}
admin.fallbackDescription: What every agent without its own list switches to when its model fails, in order.
admin.retentionHint: Days Hermes keeps the transcripts of ended runs and chats. Empty: Hermes' default of 90 days.
admin.saved: Saved. The runners apply it on their next sync.
admin.usageDescription: What the agents of a team spent, from Helena's token ledger, with cost by the model price table.
admin.compressionThresholdHint: For every agent without its own value. 100,000 keeps long chats well below the windows of today’s models without summarising runs mid-work too often.
admin.bundledSkillsHint: Helena seeds them the same way into every Hermes profile (docx, pdf, xlsx, debugging …). Turn single ones off on the agent. “Only the essential” seeds no new ones; existing ones stay.
